types.name: Functional bug
lookFor: Wrong result, wrong number or wrong total
Saved data lost, duplicated or saved in the wrong place
An error, a crash or a page that does not load
A button or link that does nothing or goes to the wrong place
Invalid, empty or special-character input that is accepted, valid input that is rejected, or long input that breaks the page or is lost
Double-click, Back after submit, refresh or a second tab that leaves duplicates or a stuck state
A state on screen that does not match what happened
A console error or a failed request (4xx, 5xx) during normal use, even if the screen looks fine
API: success (2xx, exit 0) when the action did not happen: read the state back, a response alone is not completion
API: one input that breaks one rule is accepted, or the error names the wrong field
API: the same request or command run twice makes two effects (two records, two charges, two emails)

types.name: Usability issue
lookFor: The next step is not clear, or the main action is hard to find
Too many steps or clicks for a frequent task
No loading state or feedback after an action, or feedback that disappears too fast to read
A destructive or costly action with no confirmation, or no way to undo
The user must remember something from another screen
Similar screens or dialogs behave differently
A form loses what the user typed (not saved yet) after an error, Back or refresh
An empty state that does not say what to do next

types.name: Visual issue
lookFor: Overlapping, clipped or cut text, or elements hidden behind others
Content wider than the screen, or sideways scroll
Controls too small to tap, or off screen, at phone width
Misaligned items, uneven spacing, or components that look different from the same component elsewhere
Broken images or icons
Layout that jumps while the page loads
Colors that do not match the meaning, for example a green Delete button

types.name: Copy issue
lookFor: Raw technical text: status codes, validator messages, IDs, unformatted numbers, dates or prices
An error that does not say what went wrong or how to fix it
Typos, wrong names, or the same thing called by two names
Placeholder text, or text in the wrong language
Text that says something different from what the action does
Jargon the user does not know

types.name: Accessibility issue
lookFor: A control you cannot reach or use with the keyboard alone (Tab, Enter, Space, Esc), or focus that gets stuck
No visible focus, or focus that jumps in an odd order
A button, icon, image or field with no name or label a screen reader could read
Text too faint to read against its background, or meaning shown by color alone
A dialog that does not take focus, does not close with Esc, or loses your place when it closes
Content cut off or hidden at 200% zoom

types.name: Performance issue
lookFor: An action that takes several seconds, even with a loading state
The same request sent twice, or many requests for one action
A page that gets slow with many items, if you can load or create many
Flicker or a full reload where a small update would do

types.name: Security or privacy issue
lookFor: An action that a user without permission can still do
Changing an ID in the URL opens a record this user should not see
Another user's data, tokens or secrets in a page, the URL, the console or a network response
Typed HTML or script that renders or runs
A page that still works after sign-out, through Back or a saved link
API: another account's or role's id in a request is accepted

A link the app itself checks, records or names as one host (not the label a user typed) but that opens another: encoded userinfo (https://brand.com%2F@evil.example), an @, a backslash, look-alike or Unicode dots, an IP or hex host, or an open redirect on a trusted host (translate.google.com, linkedin.com/redir, youtube.com/redirect)
A rule the page keeps that the server does not: what the server stored, logged or let through differs from what the page showed

API: a record's lifecycle or structure taken as the page never sends it: a step twice or out of order (confirm, activate, delete in use), more than the limit at once, a duplicate id, a nested or unknown part

types.name: Feature gap
lookFor: A standard feature this person expects, from comparable products, that is missing
A task this person can do only with a workaround
